notes.title: Mech Academy release date!
notes.notes:
Hi, everybody,

We wanted to inform you that the release date of the game is confirmed and will be December 15, 2023! Buckle up and get ready to pilot your Mech! 

It is the year 2175 and you are the pilot of a Guardian Mech. Gigantic war machines built to defend Earth from the Noxa, a ruthless alien race intent on conquering your planet. As a result of a mysterious experiment, you have been catapulted two centuries forward in time...

Follow our community page to be updated on news and the status of the game.

notes.title: Intruder on the bridge status update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045352/fecd9e8e8eded725d358f7031cdf7cf47e16b2a9.png

We are working hard to complete this beautiful project which will come to life in a few weeks. The implementation of mingame and the ambitious realization of very long videos (even 60 seconds), put us in difficulty, but we managed to overcome these difficulties. So keep following us and we are sure that intruder on the bridge will make you really happy!
